title: MeClear: Cooperative Game-Theoretic Attribution and Risk-Aware Memory Clearance for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2609.09115v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Long horizon Large Language Model (LLM) agents rely on external memory systems to preserve user preferences and task knowledge across extended interactions. Conventional retrieval mechanisms optimize semantic compatibility rather than downstream utility, frequently introducing outdated, misleading, or conflicting evidence into the active context. We present MeClear, a task conditioned memory clearance framework that identifies memories featuring negative downstream utility through cooperative attribution and selectively suppresses them from agent execution. MeClear combines Leave One Out screening with sampled cooperative Shapley attribution to distribute utility across interacting evidence, effectively resolving redundant conflict masking where single removal evaluations fail. translated_title: MeClear：面向长时程大语言模型智能体的合作博弈论归因与风险感知记忆清除框架
translated_abstract: 长时程大语言模型（LLM）智能体依赖外部记忆系统在长时间的交互过程中保存用户偏好和任务知识。传统的检索机制优化的是语义兼容性而非下游效用，经常将过时的、误导性的或相互冲突的证据引入活跃上下文中。我们提出了MeClear，这是一个任务条件化的记忆清除框架，它通过合作归因识别出具有负面下游效用的记忆，并有选择地将其从智能体执行中抑制。MeClear将留一法筛选与采样的合作式Shapley归因相结合，在相互作用的证据之间分配效用，有效解决了单一移除评估失效时冗余证据相互冲突掩蔽的问题。利用归因排序，MeClear在嵌套过滤的基础上执行查询范围内的最小清除策略，并在清除后的上下文上验证任务恢复。
tldr: MeClear提出了一种结合留一法筛选与合作式Shapley归因的任务条件化记忆清除框架，能够识别对长时程LLM智能体产生负面下游效用的有害记忆，并通过查询范围内的最小清除策略有选择地将其从智能体上下文中移除。
en_tdlr: MeClear is a task-conditioned memory clearance framework that combines Leave-One-Out screening with sampled cooperative Shapley attribution to identify memories with negative downstream utility and selectively suppress them from long-horizon LLM agents' execution through a query-scoped minimal clearance strategy.
